# Raven – The First Descendant (Nexon)

> A Non-Attribute Melee DPS who uses the shadows to wreak havoc on enemy lines. She unleashes a fierce assault on enemies with a shotgun made of shadows. Unofficial fan page with official data only (NEXON library + Nexon Open API, 01.10.2026).

Page: https://raven.freyna.org/
Full plain-text data: https://raven.freyna.org/llms-full.txt
Official library: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/descendants/101000035

All values on this page are max level: Descendant stats at Lv 40 (max), modules at their max enhancement level (Transcendent modules Lv 10). Weapons on the TFD pages are always listed at Lv 100 with 4 stars (Unique Ability Level 4).

## Key facts
- Attribute: Non-Attribute · Arche type of all skills: Fusion · Custom Resource: Umbra (Max MP 0)
- Former name: Eleanore · Title: Queen of Darkness · Voice actor (EN): Janine Harouni
- Ultimate Raven: none (as of 01.10.2026)
- Lv 40 (max) stats: Max HP 1,516 / Max Shield 1,006 / Max MP 0 / DEF 1,858 / Shield Recovery Out of Combat 4.88 / Shield Recovery In Combat 4.08
- Skills: Queen of Darkness (Passive Skill); Shadow Shot (Active Skill); Raven Feather (Active Skill); Shadow Step (Active Skill); Vendetta (Active Skill)
- Exclusive modules: Nightfall (Transcendent); Law of the Back Alley (Transcendent); Shadow's Resolve (Ancestors)
- Research: Raven 16 Hours / 400,000 Gold / Raven Enhanced Cells x1
